{{Quote|Oh, oh… no, no, sir. Not again. Please, no.|A Troglof attendant, to a Hutt|<ref name="SC 105" />|audio=EatingTroglof.mp3}}
Around [[9 ABY]],<ref>{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> a [[Color|grayish]]-skinned, orange-[[eye]]d [[Gender|male]] '''Hutt''' was a guest to<ref name="SC 105" /> [[Skull Ridge Mountain Hotel & Spa]]<ref>{{Getty|url=thewaltdisneystudios/allaccess/#!asset/bj8gqtnvm799njt6mjc6t|text=GR-FF-001420|date=2024-12-23}}</ref> on the [[planet]] of [[Lanupa]]. One [[Standard day|day]], while relaxing in a [[mud bath]], the [[Hutt]] was served a tray of [[Foodstuff|food]] by a [[Unidentified Troglof spa attendant|Troglof attendant]]. Dissatisfied with the contents of the tray, the Hutt instead grasped the attendant<ref name="SC 105" /> himself<ref name="SC 105 AD">{{SkeletonCrew|You Have a Lot to Learn About Pirates}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> and ate him,<ref name="Wainerdi:2024">{{SW|url=news/skeleton-crew-skywalker-sound-interview|text=The Strange and Familiar Sounds of ''Star Wars: Skeleton Crew''|author=Brandon Wainerdi|date=2024-12-26}}</ref> shrugging off his desperate pleas not to do so again.<ref name="SC 105" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I cut little 'splurty', disgusting bubbles. Every single one that pops in that Hutt pit was cut by hand. And then, of course, I voiced the Hutt myself.|David W. Collins on the development of the Hutt|<ref name="Wainerdi:2024" />}}
The Hutt first appeared in "[[You Have a Lot to Learn About Pirates]]," the fifth episode of the live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'', streaming on [[Disney+]]. The character was voiced by one of the series' sound editors, [[David W. Collins]]. In addition, Collins manually cut the popping sounds that are heard in the scene with the Hutt.<ref name="Wainerdi:2024" />
